body.statement:
If \(S\subseteq\mathbb R^{m+k}\) is semialgebraic, then its coordinate projection
\[
\{y\in\mathbb R^k:\exists x\in\mathbb R^m,\ (x,y)\in S\}
\]
is semialgebraic.

attestation.note: The stable arXiv source and exact displayed-theorem locator are supplied; the emitted claim is precisely the coordinate-projection instance used in the proof.
